build_wav2vec_classification_model: build a wav2vec classification model using Wav2VecClassification.build_model with config and task
create_mean_pooling_layer: create a MeanPoolingFast layer that computes mean-pooled features with padding mask support
create_amsoftmax_pooling_layer: create a MeanPoolingFastAMSoftmax layer that computes cosine similarity for angular margin softmax
create_layer_weighted_pooling: create a LayerWeightedMeanPooling layer that computes Elmo-style weighted average across encoder layers
run_wav2vec_forward_pass: run a forward pass through Wav2VecClassification to get classification logits from audio features
